dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: The Sacred Mountain seems to be having some tummy troubles. It pukes stuff out every day. You've seen it too. It's too dangerous to go out and play!

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: In Uncle Kimosi's stories, whenever the volcano's having tummy troubles, all it needs is a few good pats and it starts to feel better... If only my hands were bigger...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: I'm sure the grown-ups could pat it better, but they don't want us playing outside the tribe, so they keep puttin' it off.

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Haha, so that's what you think, huh? If you ask me, the Sacred Mountain's so big, we'd need the whole tribe to pat the tummy ache away.

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: But the grown-ups are all so busy! Just look at Varesa working in the orchard all day long. We've gotta wait until they all have the free time to pat the volcano together.

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Hmm, you make a good point... *sigh* So we'll just have to wait until the grown-ups get some free time, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: And until then, we follow their rules and don't go outside the tribe until the Sacred Mountain has calmed down, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: ...Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you two discussing? Paimon just heard a lot of talk about "patting tummies"...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: We were talking about... ah...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: We were talking about tribal secrets that strange outlanders aren't supposed to know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, patting volcanoes is a "tribal secret"...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Wh—What!? Did you hear everything?

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: You were talking too loudly! The next time you want to discuss secrets, whisper into my ear, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Okay... *sigh* But won't that be a little too, uh... close in?

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Haha, if you say so. Well then, outlander guest, I'm Duniya, and this hapless idiot is Dutse...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Will you stop calling me an idiot?

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Collective of Plenty! And welcome to your little Tepetlisaurus... That's odd, there should be runes that stop outside saurians from entering the tribe... Does this have something to do with the Sacred Mountain being in a bad way?

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Hmph, this just shows that the runes need a good pat too!

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: The only thing around here that needs a good hard pat is your head! *sigh* It's a good job you don't look like bad people...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Anyway, what is it you're here for?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You introduce yourselves to Duniya and Dutse...\nAnd explain that you wish to enter the Sacred Mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: You want to enter the Sacred Mountain!? That's not going to be easy... The grown-ups keep telling us it's a dangerous place, so we're not allowed to go in there...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: But I'm sure you have your reasons for wanting to go...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Hmm... I know there was once someone else who found a way in...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: M—Me too! I know someone too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, isn't the Sacred Mountain, well, sacred to your tribe? How come you're so happy to tell us all about it?

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: The name "Sacred Mountain" comes from woven scrolls from a long, long time ago... As far as we're concerned, it's nowhere near as sacred as the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: The only reason we're not allowed to go inside is because it's dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Not to mention, the Speaker's Chamber has organized exploration teams to go inside and poke around... Hehe, as soon as I'm old enough, I'm going to go there too!

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: How many times do you need to be told? That place is dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm unsure of the details, but if you want, you could try talking to <color=#00E1FFFF>Old Man Mposo</color>. I'm sure he'd be more than happy to help.

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: "Idle Old Man Mposo"? You'd be better off asking <color=#00E1FFFF>Kimosi</color>. Hehe, Kimosi's my uncle, and he used to be an adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Don't call Old Man Mposo idle! Uhh... Unfortunately, one of them's at <color=#00E1FFFF>the excavation site south of the mountain</color> and the other's at <color=#00E1FFFF>the Tephric Ruins west of the village</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: If only we could show you the way, but with the Sacred Mountain in its eruption cycle, it's not safe for us to take you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No problem! Paimon thinks we can find our own way from here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #C'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! It's time to go!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Hehe, he's a little cutie, isn't he? That scarf tied to his tail is so pretty. When the Sacred Mountain's feeling better, let us take him out to play!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay! But Paimon wants to come too!

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Oh, outlander hero, did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Couldn't find the excavation site and the Tephric Ruins? I guess we'll have to... "bend" the grown-ups' little rule then...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: *sigh* Oh, alright... I won't go outside the tribe...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: #So, {NICKNAME}... What would you like to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the excavation site...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Oh, it should really be called the Remnants of the Secret Source excavation site. It's a large area of ruins to the south of the Sacred Mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: It's said that they were abandoned by dragons, long, long ago. Old Man Mposo patrols the area daily to keep marauding Treasure Hoarders away...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: He used to be interested in ruins and relics. He even joined the Saurian Relics Association back in the day. He likes to tell us all stories of the past.

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: But he's no good at storytelling — he's just so boooring. It's all dusty old details, like seeing "referential" totems in patterns on the stone...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: I think you mean "reverential" totems... Old Man Mposo's more of an archaeologist than a storyteller...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Apparently, he once explored the volcano itself. He might just be able to help you out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Tephric Ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Aha! So, you want to know about the Tephric Ruins? Now, that's something I do know about!

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Long, long ago... back when Natlan was still a peaceful paradise...

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Ah, actually, it was 500 years ago, just as the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan was at its worst — an entire section of ruins was spat out by the volcano, completely intact!

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, Duniya, why do you always have to interrupt my story!?

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Because every time you tell this one, you always start with this "Long, long ago" stuff... No one wants to hear it!

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: ...I mean, that's how Uncle Kimosi told me the story, and he was a member of the exploration team assembled by the Speaker's Chamber!

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: I've heard there've been traces of the Abyss discovered around the Tephric Ruins again recently. I wonder how Uncle Kimosi's doing...

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: If you do go there, can you check on how he's doing for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have no more questions.

dialogues.speaker: Duniya
dialogues.text: Then I wish you a successful journey!

dialogues.speaker: Dutse
dialogues.text: Hehe, drop by again!
